evidenceLevels.observed_transition: not-enabled then enabled was directly observed; the true instant lies in [enabledWindowStart, enabledWindowEnd]
evidenceLevels.observed_arrival_enabled: first seen already enabled, but created at or after the ledger start; the true instant lies in [created, first observation]
evidenceLevels.enabled_before_ledger: already enabled at first sighting AND created before the ledger began; the instant is UNKNOWN and the account is not cohort-eligible
